doctorMode.title: 医生模式
doctorMode.dashboardSubtitle: 健康日志、医患关联与共享读数
doctorMode.subtitle: 记录您的读数，在您同意时与医生关联，并仅共享您允许的类别。应用绝不会把数值标注为偏高、偏低或危险。

gate.title: 需要医生权限
gate.needVerifiedPlan: 医生模式下的患者数据仅在医生方案有效且职业执照（cédula）已验证时可查看。未验证的医生无法查看任何患者数据。

onboarding.title: 医生资料
onboarding.hint: 填写您的职业信息。验证通过自动化职业执照核验（第1阶段为模拟服务商）。
onboarding.name: 姓名
onboarding.required: 姓名、专科和执照号码为必填项。

linking.title: 患者 ↔ 医生关联
linking.hubHint: 创建短期邀请码或输入对方代码。您确认关联并控制每一项授权（默认全部关闭）。
linking.manageLinks: 管理已关联医生与授权
linking.inviteShare: 分享此代码（{{minutes}} 分钟后失效）：{{code}}
linking.enterDoctorHint: 输入医生分享的代码。在共享任何数据前您需要确认。
linking.enterPatientHint: 输入患者分享的代码。您必须已验证且拥有有效医生方案。
linking.linked: 关联已确认。授权类别默认全部关闭。
linking.invalid: 邀请码无效或已被使用。
linking.doctorNotReady: 医生必须完成执照验证并拥有有效医生方案。
linking.consentHint: 每一类默认关闭。仅打开您希望该医生看到的内容。撤销后立即切断访问。
linking.revokeMessage: 该医生将立即失去对您共享数据的访问权限。

bitacora.title: 健康日志
bitacora.hubHint: 快速记录血压、血糖、体重和症状——仅保存原始数值。
bitacora.disclaimer: 数值按您输入的内容保存。应用不会将其解释为正常、偏高、偏低或危险。
bitacora.bpRequired: 请输入收缩压和舒张压。
bitacora.chartsHint: 仅绘制您的数值曲线——无参考区间，无风险颜色。

doctor.hubHint: 需要医生方案 + 已验证执照。未验证的医生无法查看患者数据。
doctor.noPatients: 尚无已关联且授权有效的患者。
doctor.rawOnly: 共享读数仅为原始数值——无临床标签。
doctor.adherenceSharedHint: 在可用时共享提醒依从性。

alerts.title: 告警限值
alerts.hint: 仅在新读数越过我设置的限值时通知我。告警绝不会声称某个值偏高、偏低或危险。
alerts.pushBody: 有一条读数超过了您设置的限值。打开应用查看详情。
alerts.crossedLimitDetail: 有一条读数超过了您设置的限值。
alerts.crossedLimitDetailNamed: Reading {{observed}} {{relation}} the limit of {{limit}} that you configured

patientHub.title: 健康日志与医生
patientHub.dashboardSubtitle: 记录读数并控制医生可见内容
patientHub.subtitle: 记录您的读数，并在您同意时与医生关联。医生使用独立的 AuricRX 医生端应用。
patientHub.auditHint: 近期的关联、授权与医生读取事件。
patientHub.doctorAppNote: 您的医生在 AuricRX 医生端（com.auricrx.doctors）查看共享数据，而不是在此患者应用内。

compliance.disclaimer: AuricRX Médicos is a tool for organizing information. It does not replace your clinical judgment.
compliance.disclaimerShort: Organizing tool — does not replace clinical judgment.
compliance.notForEmergencies: This channel is not for emergencies. For emergencies, use local emergency services.

digest.title: Morning digest
digest.subtitle: Only what is new since your last look — sorted by recency, not by health status.

preVisit.title: Pre-visit one-pager
preVisit.subtitle: Descriptive counts, last readings with dates, dose-log totals, patient questions, and new files.
preVisit.empty: Nothing to show for this period.

preVisitIntake.title: Pre-visit intake
preVisitIntake.subtitle: The patient's own words, organized for the visit. This is not a medical opinion.
preVisitIntake.chatDeleted: The conversation is no longer available. The confirmed summary and comment were kept.
preVisitIntake.empty: No pre-visit intake for this patient.

appointmentRequest.title: Request appointment
appointmentRequest.subtitle: Draft a message, review it, then send. Nothing is written to your calendar.
appointmentRequest.sent: Request sent for the patient to review.

calendar.title: Today's agenda
calendar.subtitle: Read-only from Google or Outlook. All times use your timezone.
calendar.stubHint: Calendar OAuth is not connected yet. Agenda stays unavailable (fail closed).
calendar.stale: Calendar sync is stale. Agenda hidden until a fresh sync succeeds.

officeHours.title: Office hours
officeHours.subtitle: You choose which days and time windows accept patient messages, in your timezone. You can pause messaging while away. Outside your windows, messages queue for the next one.
officeHours.windowsHint: Windows per day (24h). Example: 09:00-13:00, 16:00-20:00. Leave blank to close that day.
officeHours.pausedHint: Messaging is paused. New patient messages stay queued until you resume.

aiInsights.title: AI insights
aiInsights.body: Registered AI review is not available in Phase 1. Join the waitlist if you want to hear when it opens.

messaging.title: Messages
messaging.needsActionHint: Structured patient requests that are due in your current office window.
messaging.notForEmergencies: This channel is not for emergencies.
messaging.writeHint: Choose a request type. This is not open chat and not for emergencies.
messaging.queuedNotice: Outside office hours. Your message is queued for the doctor's next window. No reply is expected until then.
messaging.pausedNotice: The doctor paused messaging. Your message is queued. No reply is expected until messaging resumes.
